title: 水處理臭氧氧化~Ozone oxidation in water treatment
focus: 臭氧氣液傳質、需求、反應與副產物~Ozone gas-liquid transfer, demand, reaction and byproducts
summary: 本課以臭氧氣液傳質、需求、反應與副產物為主線，從處理目的與前驅物、原料氣與乾燥邊界、產生、注入與尾氣、需求與殘留衰減進入十個相連的技術單元。每單元依機制、數量模型、驗證與失效辨識逐步操作，最後完成包含單位、敏感度及邊界的工程工作單。數值均為原創教學假設，不是特定設施實測或現場操作設定。~This course develops ozone gas-liquid transfer, demand, reaction and byproducts through ten connected units, beginning with treatment goals and precursors, feed-gas conditioning boundary, generation, injection and off-gas, demand and residual decay. Each unit moves through mechanism, quantitative model, verification and failure diagnosis, ending in a worksheet with units, sensitivity and applicability. All example numbers are original teaching assumptions, not facility measurements or live operating settings.

units.title: 處理目的與前驅物~Treatment goals and precursors
units.mechanism: 先區分消毒、色味或特定化合物氧化目標；不同水質的臭氧需求與副產物路徑不同。~Separate disinfection, color/odor and target-compound oxidation goals; ozone demand and byproduct pathways depend on water quality.
units.model: 原創教學假設：Cin=100 mg/L；Cout=20 mg/L。模型 η=(Cin-Cout)/Cin，代入得到 0.8 fraction。適用邊界：濃度去除率僅在進出流量相等時等於質量去除率。~Original teaching assumptions: Cin=100 mg/L; Cout=20 mg/L. Model η=(Cin-Cout)/Cin gives 0.8 fraction. Applicability: Concentration removal equals mass removal only for equal inlet/outlet flow.
units.verify: 在離線工作台先選取「處理目的與前驅物」的觀測點。用相同分析方法與流量加權樣本，另列流量差異。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。~In the offline workbench, select the observation point for treatment goals and precursors. Use matching methods and flow-weighted samples and report any flow difference. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.
units.failure: 只以去色當所有污染物已去除。診斷與介入：配對進出水流量及分析基準，另外確認轉化產物。~Decolorization is used to claim removal of all contaminants. Diagnostic response: Match inlet/outlet flow and analysis bases and check transformation products separately.
units.misconception: 顏色消失等於所有有機碳礦化。~Loss of color means all organic carbon is mineralized.
units.practice: 只改變 Cout:20→30 mg/L，其餘假設固定；結果應由 0.8 變為 0.7 fraction。用「處理目的與前驅物」的機制解釋方向，再提出一項可區分模型失效與儀器偏差的量測。工程輔助可示範此計算，但完成紀錄應標示使用輔助。~Change only Cout:20→30 mg/L, holding the other assumptions fixed; the result changes from 0.8 to 0.7 fraction. Explain the direction using treatment goals and precursors, then propose a measurement separating model failure from instrument bias. Engineering assistance may demonstrate this calculation; mark assisted completion in the record.

units.title: 原料氣與乾燥邊界~Feed-gas conditioning boundary
units.mechanism: 發生器需要相容的原料氣與冷卻條件；乾燥只是一個子程序，不能讓學徒操作高壓電或氣體系統。~Generators require compatible feed gas and cooling; drying is one subsystem, and the learner does not operate high-voltage or gas equipment.
units.model: 原創教學假設：入口水蒸氣負荷=20 kg/d；冷凝去除=15 kg/d。模型 Mremain=Min-Mcond，代入得到 5 kg water/d。適用邊界：水分收支不等於露點合格；還須氣壓、氣溫及含濕量。~Original teaching assumptions: Inlet water-vapor load=20 kg/d; condensed removal=15 kg/d. Model Mremain=Min-Mcond gives 5 kg water/d. Applicability: A water balance does not prove dew-point compliance; gas pressure, temperature and humidity are needed.
units.verify: 在離線工作台先選取「原料氣與乾燥邊界」的觀測點。量冷凝水並以露點儀確認乾燥器出口。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。~In the offline workbench, select the observation point for feed-gas conditioning boundary. Measure condensate and check dryer outlet with a dew-point instrument. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.
units.failure: 把除去部分冷凝水誤認為已符合設備乾燥需求。診斷與介入：另測露點與含濕，檢查排水及下游相容性。~Partial condensate removal is mistaken for meeting equipment dryness requirements. Diagnostic response: Measure dew point/moisture separately and check drainage/downstream compatibility.
units.misconception: 量到冷凝水就足以證明露點合格。~Collected condensate alone proves an acceptable dew point.
units.practice: 只改變 Mcond:15→17 kg/d，其餘假設固定；結果應由 5 變為 3 kg water/d。用「原料氣與乾燥邊界」的機制解釋方向，再提出一項可區分模型失效與儀器偏差的量測。工程輔助可示範此計算，但完成紀錄應標示使用輔助。~Change only Mcond:15→17 kg/d, holding the other assumptions fixed; the result changes from 5 to 3 kg water/d. Explain the direction using feed-gas conditioning boundary, then propose a measurement separating model failure from instrument bias. Engineering assistance may demonstrate this calculation; mark assisted completion in the record.

units.title: 產生、注入與尾氣~Generation, injection and off-gas
units.mechanism: 用產生量、尾氣與水相殘留區分傳入水中與實際反應；氣體產量不等於有效處理量。~Separate generated ozone, off-gas and aqueous residual to distinguish transferred ozone from reacted ozone.
units.model: 原創教學假設：氣體臭氧進入=10 kg/h；尾氣=2 kg/h。模型 ηtransfer=1-Moff/Min，代入得到 0.8 fraction。適用邊界：傳入液體不等於有效消毒消耗；水中需求與殘餘分開。~Original teaching assumptions: Ozone gas input=10 kg/h; off-gas ozone=2 kg/h. Model ηtransfer=1-Moff/Min gives 0.8 fraction. Applicability: Transfer to water is not effective disinfection consumption; separate demand and residual.
units.verify: 在離線工作台先選取「產生、注入與尾氣」的觀測點。配對氣相流量與臭氧分析，再查液相殘餘。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。~In the offline workbench, select the observation point for generation, injection and off-gas. Pair gas flow/ozone analysis and check liquid residual. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.
units.failure: 只以發生器輸出估算水中有效劑量。診斷與介入：同步校正氣體輸入、尾氣與水相殘留，關閉臭氧收支。~Generator output alone is used as effective aqueous dose. Diagnostic response: Synchronize/calibrate feed gas, off-gas and aqueous residual and close the ozone balance.
units.misconception: 產生的臭氧百分之百都會溶入水中。~All generated ozone dissolves in water.
units.practice: 只改變 Moff:2→3 kg/h，其餘假設固定；結果應由 0.8 變為 0.7 fraction。用「產生、注入與尾氣」的機制解釋方向，再提出一項可區分模型失效與儀器偏差的量測。工程輔助可示範此計算，但完成紀錄應標示使用輔助。~Change only Moff:2→3 kg/h, holding the other assumptions fixed; the result changes from 0.8 to 0.7 fraction. Explain the direction using generation, injection and off-gas, then propose a measurement separating model failure from instrument bias. Engineering assistance may demonstrate this calculation; mark assisted completion in the record.

units.title: 需求與殘留衰減~Demand and residual decay
units.mechanism: 天然有機物與其他還原物會消耗臭氧；簡化一階模型要由實測殘留時間曲線檢查。~Natural organic matter and other reductants consume ozone; test a first-order approximation against residual-time data.
units.model: 原創教學假設：C0=1 mg/L；假設 k=0.10 min⁻¹；t=10 min。模型 C=C0 exp(-kt)，代入得到 0.36787944 mg/L。適用邊界：單一一階批次近似；不是複雜天然水的完整反應網路。~Original teaching assumptions: C0=1 mg/L; assumed k=0.10 min⁻¹; t=10 min. Model C=C0 exp(-kt) gives 0.36787944 mg/L. Applicability: Single first-order batch approximation, not a complete natural-water reaction network.
units.verify: 在離線工作台先選取「需求與殘留衰減」的觀測點。用多時點殘餘測量擬合，另留驗證樣本。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。~In the offline workbench, select the observation point for demand and residual decay. Fit multiple residual measurements and retain validation samples. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.
units.failure: 以清水的衰減係數套到不同原水。診斷與介入：用同原水實測時間序列重擬合，檢查一階模型殘差。~A clean-water decay coefficient is applied to another source water. Diagnostic response: Refit a matched-water time series and inspect first-order-model residuals.
units.misconception: 投加後殘留永遠保持固定。~Residual remains constant after dosing.
units.practice: 只改變 k:0.10→0.15 min⁻¹，其餘假設固定；結果應由 0.36787944 變為 0.22313016 mg/L。用「需求與殘留衰減」的機制解釋方向，再提出一項可區分模型失效與儀器偏差的量測。工程輔助可示範此計算，但完成紀錄應標示使用輔助。~Change only k:0.10→0.15 min⁻¹, holding the other assumptions fixed; the result changes from 0.36787944 to 0.22313016 mg/L. Explain the direction using demand and residual decay, then propose a measurement separating model failure from instrument bias. Engineering assistance may demonstrate this calculation; mark assisted completion in the record.

units.title: 接觸池與 CT~Contactor hydraulics and CT
units.mechanism: 有效接觸時間來自示蹤與水力條件，CT 應使用相應區段殘留而非單純名義槽容。~Effective contact time depends on tracer/hydraulic evidence; CT uses the relevant compartment residual, not nominal volume alone.
units.model: 原創教學假設：殘餘濃度 C=0.4 mg/L；T10=8 min。模型 CT=C T10，代入得到 3.2 mg·min/L。適用邊界：簡化定濃度接觸值；實際需沿程衰減與適用微生物的驗證。~Original teaching assumptions: Residual C=0.4 mg/L; T10=8 min. Model CT=C T10 gives 3.2 mg·min/L. Applicability: Constant-concentration simplification; actual decay and organism-specific validation are required.
units.verify: 在離線工作台先選取「接觸池與 CT」的觀測點。以示蹤 T10 配對接觸槽殘餘濃度，別用名義 V/Q 取代。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。~In the offline workbench, select the observation point for contactor hydraulics and ct. Pair tracer-derived T10 with residual concentration instead of substituting nominal V/Q. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.
units.failure: 將平均停留時間當最短有效接觸時間。診斷與介入：重新配對示蹤 T10 與殘留剖面，不由名義容積推論消毒。~Mean residence is treated as minimum effective contact time. Diagnostic response: Pair tracer T10 with residual profiles rather than inferring disinfection from nominal volume.
units.misconception: 相同 C×t 在任何水質與病原上都等效。~Equal C×t is universally equivalent across waters and organisms.
units.practice: 只改變 T10:8→6 min，其餘假設固定；結果應由 3.2 變為 2.4 mg·min/L。用「接觸池與 CT」的機制解釋方向，再提出一項可區分模型失效與儀器偏差的量測。工程輔助可示範此計算，但完成紀錄應標示使用輔助。~Change only T10:8→6 min, holding the other assumptions fixed; the result changes from 3.2 to 2.4 mg·min/L. Explain the direction using contactor hydraulics and ct, then propose a measurement separating model failure from instrument bias. Engineering assistance may demonstrate this calculation; mark assisted completion in the record.

units.title: 目標轉化與礦化~Target transformation versus mineralization
units.mechanism: 母體濃度下降可能只是轉化成其他產物，需另外量總有機碳與目標產物。~Declining parent-compound concentration may reflect transformation, requiring separate total-organic-carbon and product measurements.
units.model: 原創教學假設：Cin=100 mg/L；Cout=20 mg/L。模型 η=(Cin-Cout)/Cin，代入得到 0.8 fraction。適用邊界：濃度去除率僅在進出流量相等時等於質量去除率。~Original teaching assumptions: Cin=100 mg/L; Cout=20 mg/L. Model η=(Cin-Cout)/Cin gives 0.8 fraction. Applicability: Concentration removal equals mass removal only for equal inlet/outlet flow.
units.verify: 在離線工作台先選取「目標轉化與礦化」的觀測點。用相同分析方法與流量加權樣本，另列流量差異。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。~In the offline workbench, select the observation point for target transformation versus mineralization. Use matching methods and flow-weighted samples and report any flow difference. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.
units.failure: 母體去除率直接稱為礦化率。診斷與介入：配對進出水流量及分析基準，另外確認轉化產物。~Parent removal is labeled mineralization. Diagnostic response: Match inlet/outlet flow and analysis bases and check transformation products separately.
units.misconception: 氧化一定把所有污染物變成二氧化碳和水。~Oxidation always turns every contaminant into carbon dioxide and water.
units.practice: 只改變 Cout:20→30 mg/L，其餘假設固定；結果應由 0.8 變為 0.7 fraction。用「目標轉化與礦化」的機制解釋方向，再提出一項可區分模型失效與儀器偏差的量測。工程輔助可示範此計算，但完成紀錄應標示使用輔助。~Change only Cout:20→30 mg/L, holding the other assumptions fixed; the result changes from 0.8 to 0.7 fraction. Explain the direction using target transformation versus mineralization, then propose a measurement separating model failure from instrument bias. Engineering assistance may demonstrate this calculation; mark assisted completion in the record.

units.title: 副產物敏感度~Byproduct sensitivity
units.mechanism: 含溴原水等情境需評估特定副產物；使用假想比例只練習敏感度，實際必須靠中試與分析。~Bromide-containing waters require specific byproduct assessment; a hypothetical fraction teaches sensitivity, while actual prediction requires pilot testing and analysis.
units.model: 原創教學假設：假想前驅物=100 µg/L；表觀轉化質量比例=0.05。模型 Cby=Y×Cprecursor，代入得到 5 µg/L。適用邊界：只是敏感度算術，不是臭氧副產物的動力學或化學計量預測；比例需由中試資料辨識。~Original teaching assumptions: Hypothetical precursor=100 µg/L; apparent mass-conversion fraction=0.05. Model Cby=Y×Cprecursor gives 5 µg/L. Applicability: Sensitivity arithmetic only, not ozone-byproduct kinetics or stoichiometry; identify the fraction from pilot data.
units.verify: 在離線工作台先選取「副產物敏感度」的觀測點。以相同方法測前驅物、目標副產物及其檢出限。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。~In the offline workbench, select the observation point for byproduct sensitivity. Measure precursor, target byproduct and detection limits using consistent methods. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.
units.failure: 只提高臭氧以追求母體去除而不測副產物。診斷與介入：以中試分析取代假想比例，同時追蹤前驅物及產物。~Ozone is increased for parent removal without measuring byproducts. Diagnostic response: Replace the hypothetical fraction with pilot analysis, tracking precursor and product together.
units.misconception: 臭氧自行分解就代表不可能有反應副產物。~Ozone decomposition means reaction byproducts cannot occur.
units.practice: 只改變 Y:0.05→0.08，其餘假設固定；結果應由 5 變為 8 µg/L。用「副產物敏感度」的機制解釋方向，再提出一項可區分模型失效與儀器偏差的量測。工程輔助可示範此計算，但完成紀錄應標示使用輔助。~Change only Y:0.05→0.08, holding the other assumptions fixed; the result changes from 5 to 8 µg/L. Explain the direction using byproduct sensitivity, then propose a measurement separating model failure from instrument bias. Engineering assistance may demonstrate this calculation; mark assisted completion in the record.

units.title: 尾氣破壞與監測~Off-gas destruction and monitoring
units.mechanism: 尾氣處理要追蹤入口負荷與出口濃度；設備效率不能替代環境氣體偵測及隔離程序。~Track inlet load and outlet concentration across off-gas treatment; equipment efficiency does not replace ambient monitoring and isolation procedures.
units.model: 原創教學假設：入口 C0=100 mg/m³；出口 C=10 mg/m³。模型 B=C/C0，代入得到 0.1 fraction。適用邊界：同溫壓同成分的氣相穿透比，不是職業暴露或燃氣品質合格判定。~Original teaching assumptions: Inlet C0=100 mg/m³; outlet C=10 mg/m³. Model B=C/C0 gives 0.1 fraction. Applicability: Gas breakthrough ratio for the same species and volume basis, not occupational-exposure or fuel-quality compliance.
units.verify: 在離線工作台先選取「尾氣破壞與監測」的觀測點。比對床前床後同時採樣與氣體分析校正。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。~In the offline workbench, select the observation point for off-gas destruction and monitoring. Compare simultaneous upstream/downstream samples and gas-analyzer calibration. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.
units.failure: 只看尾氣處理設備有通電。診斷與介入：同步測入口與出口氣體成分，另檢查環境暴露監測。~Powered equipment is mistaken for verified off-gas treatment. Diagnostic response: Measure matching inlet/outlet gases and separately check ambient-exposure monitoring.
units.misconception: 無氣味可作為臭氧氣體安全證據。~Absence of odor proves ozone-gas safety.
units.practice: 只改變 C:10→25 mg/m³，其餘假設固定；結果應由 0.1 變為 0.25 fraction。用「尾氣破壞與監測」的機制解釋方向，再提出一項可區分模型失效與儀器偏差的量測。工程輔助可示範此計算，但完成紀錄應標示使用輔助。~Change only C:10→25 mg/m³, holding the other assumptions fixed; the result changes from 0.1 to 0.25 fraction. Explain the direction using off-gas destruction and monitoring, then propose a measurement separating model failure from instrument bias. Engineering assistance may demonstrate this calculation; mark assisted completion in the record.

units.title: 後續生物或碳處理~Downstream biological or carbon treatment
units.mechanism: 氧化可改變可生物利用性，後續過濾或活性碳需量自己的負荷與穿透，不能沿用前段去除率。~Oxidation can change biodegradability; downstream filtration/carbon needs its own loading and breakthrough measurements.
units.model: 原創教學假設：炭量=1000 kg；假設工作容量=0.02 kg/kg；去除負荷=0.5 kg/d。模型 t=Mq/L，代入得到 40 d。適用邊界：忽略傳質區與競爭吸附的容量上限式教學值。~Original teaching assumptions: Carbon=1000 kg; assumed working capacity=0.02 kg/kg; removed load=0.5 kg/d. Model t=Mq/L gives 40 d. Applicability: Capacity-based teaching bound neglecting mass-transfer zone and competing adsorption.
units.verify: 在離線工作台先選取「後續生物或碳處理」的觀測點。使用小柱或現場突破資料校正工作容量。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。~In the offline workbench, select the observation point for downstream biological or carbon treatment. Calibrate working capacity with small-column or field breakthrough data. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.
units.failure: 把前段氧化成效當後段長期容量。診斷與介入：用中試動態容量及競爭水質校正，規劃穿透前後的採樣。~Upstream oxidation performance is treated as downstream lifetime capacity. Diagnostic response: Refine with pilot dynamic capacity/competing water quality and plan breakthrough sampling.
units.misconception: 增加可生物分解性就是已經去除有機碳。~Greater biodegradability means organic carbon has already been removed.
units.practice: 只改變 q:0.02→0.015 kg/kg，其餘假設固定；結果應由 40 變為 30 d。用「後續生物或碳處理」的機制解釋方向，再提出一項可區分模型失效與儀器偏差的量測。工程輔助可示範此計算，但完成紀錄應標示使用輔助。~Change only q:0.02→0.015 kg/kg, holding the other assumptions fixed; the result changes from 40 to 30 d. Explain the direction using downstream biological or carbon treatment, then propose a measurement separating model failure from instrument bias. Engineering assistance may demonstrate this calculation; mark assisted completion in the record.

units.title: 水質與能耗共同驗證~Joint water-quality and energy verification
units.mechanism: 在相同水量與原水背景比較目標物、殘留、副產物及總能耗，保持實際驗證範圍。~Compare targets, residual, byproducts and total electricity at matched flow/source quality while retaining the validated envelope.
units.model: 原創教學假設：電力 E=960 kWh/d；處理量 Q=3000 m³/d。模型 SEC=E/Q，代入得到 0.32 kWh/m³。適用邊界：同一系統邊界與同一日；需同時滿足出流水品質。~Original teaching assumptions: Electricity E=960 kWh/d; flow Q=3000 m³/d. Model SEC=E/Q gives 0.32 kWh/m³. Applicability: Use identical system boundaries and days; effluent quality must also be satisfied.
units.verify: 在離線工作台先選取「水質與能耗共同驗證」的觀測點。同步讀取電表、流量計與水質趨勢。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。~In the offline workbench, select the observation point for joint water-quality and energy verification. Synchronize electricity, flow and water-quality trends. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.
units.failure: 用電降低卻忽略接觸不足與副產物。診斷與介入：配對相同流量與出水品質再比較能耗，列出附屬設備。~Lower power conceals inadequate contact and byproducts. Diagnostic response: Compare energy at matched flow/quality and list auxiliary equipment.
units.misconception: 最低臭氧能耗永遠是最佳水處理結果。~Lowest ozone energy always gives the best treatment outcome.
units.practice: 只改變 E:960→840 kWh/d，其餘假設固定；結果應由 0.32 變為 0.28 kWh/m³。用「水質與能耗共同驗證」的機制解釋方向，再提出一項可區分模型失效與儀器偏差的量測。工程輔助可示範此計算，但完成紀錄應標示使用輔助。~Change only E:960→840 kWh/d, holding the other assumptions fixed; the result changes from 0.32 to 0.28 kWh/m³. Explain the direction using joint water-quality and energy verification, then propose a measurement separating model failure from instrument bias. Engineering assistance may demonstrate this calculation; mark assisted completion in the record.

facts: 生物、物理與化學處理都必須以同一邊界的質量及能量收支檢核。~Biological, physical and chemical treatment must be checked through mass and energy balances with consistent boundaries.
